## Preamble

<!-- We will immediately close PRs that don't comply with this template, so please make sure you follow it closely: generating code and PRs is easy, nowadays, reviewing them isn't and takes time.

Please only open a pull request if this is **NOT** about a security vulnerability. If it is, considering reporting it as a [security advisory](https://github.com/meetecho/janus-gateway/security/advisories) instead. A pull request can be done there, in case.

Delete this preamble before publishing the pull request. If you don't, we'll assume you didn't read the template. -->

## Description

<!-- Please provide a short, and human-generated, description of the issue: what you found out, what's broken, how you fixed it. Don't paste a huge bunch of AI-generated text here, and please don't have your AI summarize the change either: we'll close the PR without even reading it, if you do. We need to make sure you understand what you're contributing. More details can be added in the "Changes Made" section below. -->

## Authorship

<!-- Who wrote all this, you or your AI? Please disclose it here, and please don't lie. We don't reject AI contributions, but we **are* more careful about them, especially if the person contributing them seems clueless about what they're contributing. If AI generated the code, make sure the changes are as compact as they can be: the more code it produces, the more time it takes us to go through it all. -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
